fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode flagged ROOFTOP but moved 8439 m - the supplied lat/lng (35.814768,-90.56181) nonetheless landed directly on the Frito-Lay plant. Web research confirmed 2810 Quality Way, Jonesboro AR 72401 - a large Frito-Lay manufacturing plant producing Lay's, Ruffles, and Doritos. Street View from the surrounding farm roads confirmed the plant with silos and a Frito-Lay sign in the field.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Large modern manufacturing plant set well back from public roads across open farmland, reached by a single private access road from the west. A controlled truck gate is standard for a plant of this scale, but Street View does not cover the private drive so a barrier arm could not be directly imaged. Classified truckGate true; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolvable in available imagery; the gate would sit on the unviewable private access road. Classified remoteGs (gate, no visible shack); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock doors with trailers backed in along the building's north face; door count well into the 50+ band (~60 estimated).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard on the north side - hundreds of trailers parked in long rows; easily 50+ (200+ trailers visible).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and abundant yard space around the access road suggest physical room to add a bypass/express lane; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur curves into the property at the SW corner reaching the process/tank area - confirmed rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The plant is surrounded by open agricultural fields on the edge of Jonesboro - clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but on the developed edge of Jonesboro (a mid-size city) with neighboring industrial parcels; cellular coverage likely adequate - set false.
